message:
I couldn't fix it. The edit to `src/utils/money.js` was blocked with `EACCES: permission denied`, so nothing has changed. The yen receipt test still fails (17 of 18 tests pass).

The cause is in `formatMoney` in `src/utils/money.js`. It divides every amount by 100, so 500 JPY renders as `¥5.00` instead of `¥500`. Yen has no minor unit.

The fix I was going to make was to add a zero-decimal set (`JPY`) to `formatMoney`. Those currencies would print the integer as-is, and every other currency would keep the current two-decimal formatting. This is a shared helper, so cart totals and invoice lines would also show yen correctly.

I didn't try to get around the block, for example by writing the file through the shell. It looks like a deliberate protection, possibly a Fenceline fence on shared utils. You can choose one of these:
1. Lift the restriction on `src/utils/money.js` and I'll apply the fix there. This is the better fix.
2. I handle yen only inside `src/payments/receipt.js`. This is narrower, but cart and invoices would keep the bug.

Which do you want?
